operator_request: Remediate every finding from the completed product-code versus completed-work-packet spot check, then commit, push, and provide an overview of remaining work.

research_reopen_triggers: The Operator explicitly requests new research.
The pinned Serde behavior, Rust toolchain, dependency set, or architecture harness assumption is proven stale.
A remediation decision lacks evidence in the technical design, WP-005, WP-013, current source, or reproduced public-boundary behavior.
existing_research_sources: WP-013 current official Rust and Serde implementation research
WP-013 strict Serde DTO, public-boundary counterexample, and isolated-mutation patterns
Current storage contract, testkit, architecture fixtures, rule mapping, and gate implementation
Direct public deserialization reproductions for all three findings
patterns_found: Strict durable DTOs reject undeclared fields at every tagged-enum variant body, not only at the enclosing record.
A nonzero durable sequence must be enforced during deserialization, not only by producer convention.
A proof map is incomplete when its mutation fixtures do not touch every governed durable-wire type.
The existing isolated mutation harness and public testkit boundary can prove each correction without a new framework.
selected_approach: Apply Serde deny_unknown_fields to JournalPayload and ReconcileState.
Deserialize JournalRecord through a private wire DTO and TryFrom validation so sequence zero fails at the public wire boundary while serialization stays stable.
Add explicit validation for programmatically constructed JournalRecord values.
Add public integration tests for invalid and canonical valid wire examples.
Extend the independent testkit boundary and add one isolated architecture mutation fixture per corrected guard.
Preserve the exact prerequisite zero-progress ceiling until a shipped consumer re-proves behavior.
rejected_options: Documenting producer expectations without enforcing consumer-side decoding.
Replacing sequence with a new public newtype because it would widen the API and compatibility change.
Using only implementation-crate unit tests because they would not independently exercise the public boundary.
Keeping one diagnostics-only FF-BUILD-094 fixture because it leaves storage coverage unproved.
Adding dependencies or a separate proof framework.
reuse_opportunities: Reuse existing Serde derives and serde_json test dependency.
Reuse JournalRecord construction and storage fixtures.
Reuse xtask's isolated public-invariant mutation runner and FF-ARCH-E-WIRE-BOUNDARY diagnostic.
risks: Serde tagged-enum restrictions may interact with content representation differently than expected.
A TryFrom deserialization adapter may accidentally alter serialized JSON.
One failing assertion may mask whether later mutation fixtures exercise their own guard.
The gate may accept a fixture declaration that never changes compiled behavior.
mitigations: Test exact invalid JSON and canonical valid JSON through the public API.
Assert serialized JSON equality for valid records.
Give every architecture fixture a separate isolated mutation and expected marker.
Require the mutation runner to execute exactly one named non-ignored public test and observe its failure.
basis.validation_plan: Run the focused contract and testkit suites, independently remove each guard through three isolated architecture fixtures, run locked warnings-denied workspace tests and canonical gates, inspect persisted reports, verify invalid and valid public wire behavior, then perform a separate adversarial diff review before closure.

assumptions: The existing locked Serde dependency and Rust toolchain remain current for this bounded remediation.
The current journal JSON shape is authoritative for compatibility.
No shipped Ferric archive/journal runtime consumer exists.
non_goals: Changing valid durable-wire tags or field names.
Creating a shipped runtime or advancing product phase state.
Unrelated proof, contract, or governance cleanup.

minimum_controls: Each invalid case is tested through public serde_json deserialization.
Canonical valid records decode and serialize to the same JSON value.
Constructed records have an explicit invariant-validation method.
Each corrected guard has a distinct isolated mutation fixture and marker.
The canonical architecture gate executes all mapped fixtures.
plausible_failures: An attacker or future producer smuggles undeclared variant data that an older consumer silently ignores.
A zero sequence becomes durable and breaks ordering or replay assumptions.
A refactor removes one Serde guard while the architecture gate continues to pass on diagnostics coverage.
A mutation changes text but the exact public test runs zero cases or fails for an unrelated compile error.

execution_decomposition: Implement the smallest strict contract changes and focused public tests.
Add independent testkit assertions and one isolated mutation fixture per guard.
Run focused, aggregate, gate, and adversarial validation.
Commit closure, merge to main, verify containment, push, and report remaining authoritative work.
